recognize_zh: 一個遠大於周圍細胞的巨核細胞，核分葉、細胞質豐富呈淡紫色細顆粒狀，左上方細胞質邊緣碎裂成大量小血小板顆粒，代表巨核細胞正在釋出血小板。
features: Very large cell, many times the diameter of surrounding red cells
Lobulated nucleus with moderately condensed chromatin
Abundant pale lilac finely granular cytoplasm
Cytoplasmic periphery fragmenting into numerous platelets along one side (platelet shedding)
Small lymphocytes and erythroid cells nearby for size comparison
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a mature megakaryocyte with a lobulated nucleus and abundant finely granular lilac cytoplasm. Along one border the cytoplasm fragments into numerous platelets, indicating active platelet production. Nearby small lymphocytes and red cells provide scale. Findings are consistent with a normal mature megakaryocyte releasing platelets.

ddx.vs: Micromegakaryocytes are small, near the size of a myelocyte, with a single round nucleus, unlike this large lobulated cell.
Osteoclasts contain multiple separate round nuclei rather than a single lobulated nucleus, and they do not shed platelets.
Tumor clusters are cohesive groups of several cells with high N:C ratio and no granular cytoplasm budding into platelets.
